persona.name: Jorge Salazar
persona.background: Son of a tram worker; weekend jaranas criollas at home with uncles playing guitar and cajon; Radio Panamericana and Radio America for the nueva ola and Mexican boleros; Mexican films at the neighbourhood cinema; huaynos from Andean migrant neighbours; school dances where Los Saicos and twist were the thing.

Violeta Parra - Cueca larga de Los Meneses (Segundo pie)

Nat King Cole - Quizás, Quizás, Quizás

PE1965A.wouldSay: ¡Los Saicos! Demolición, we jumped around to that at every fiesta. Then Lucho Barrios, Jesús Vásquez, Julio Jaramillo — that's my mother's kitchen radio.
missing: Lucho Barrios - Me engañas mujer (c.1962, year unsure)
Los Troveros Criollos - Alma, corazón y vida (c.1960, year unsure)
PE1965A.fake: Three Chilean Violeta Parra field-style cuecas, a Paris-made Andean instrumental and Tito Puente's pre-Santana original are collector picks no Lima kid heard on the radio.
unsure: Jesús Vásquez - Murió el Maestro (not sure she recorded it)
Violeta Parra - La cueca del balance / Cueca del organillo (exact titles unverified)

persona.name: Faisal Mahmood
persona.background: Middle-class family; pirated cassettes from Hall Road and Anarkali; PTV pop shows and Music Channel Charts, STN; Indian film songs via VCR rentals, cable and Amritsar Doordarshan spillover; FM100 from 1995; dhol and Punjabi pop at cousins' weddings; Abida and Nusrat were his parents' and grandparents' qawwali/kafi listening.

seeds.song: Abida Parveen - Mendha Ishq Wee Toon
Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan - Mustt Mustt
Abdul Basit Abdul Samad - Surat Maryam
Pankaj Udhas - Chandi Jaisa Rang Hai Tera

PK1995A.wouldSay: Billo De Ghar! Everyone was shouting 'Billo' at weddings that year. And Dil Dil Pakistan — we sang it at school assembly.
missing: Kumar Sanu & Lata Mangeshkar - Tujhe Dekha To (1995)
Udit Narayan & Kavita Krishnamurthy - Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast Mast (1994)
PK1995A.fake: After two perfect openers it becomes a Sufi/devotional set (three obscure Abida kafis, a Real World Nusrat track, a Qur'an recitation) that is not what a teenager's tape deck played, and Bollywood film songs are missing.
unsure: Abida Parveen - Aawas Mandrrhe Kol and Ishq Na Darda (do not recognise these titles; release dates may be after 1995)

persona.name: Mihai Popescu
persona.background: Father a tractor-factory engineer; Radio România Programul 1 and 3 at home; Electrecord LPs of muzică ușoară; secretly listening to Cornel Chiriac's Metronom on Radio Free Europe; Phoenix and Sfinx at student concerts; Saturday dances at the Casa de Cultură; Cerbul de Aur broadcasts on TVR; summers at grandparents' village near Făgăraș where the radio played Maria Tănase and Maria Lătărețu.

seeds.song: Le Mystère des Voix Bulgares - Pilentse pee
Tarras Instrumental Trio - Der glater bulgar

RO1975A.wouldSay: Lume, lume... that's what bunica had on the radio in the village. But who put Bulgarian choirs, tango and a cantor in here? Where is Phoenix, where is Spătaru? This isn't what we danced to.
missing: Dan Spătaru - Ți-am dat un inel (c.1970s, year unsure)
Gică Petrescu - Ce frumoasă e iubirea (1960s, year unsure)
RO1975A.fake: After two folk evergreens it turns into a Western world-music shelf of Balkan, klezmer, tango and synagogue recordings no Romanian teenager heard in 1975, with zero muzică ușoară, rock or foreign pop.
unsure: Maria Tănase - Leliță cârciumăreasă (title not certain to be in her catalogue)
